actualHost.vendorBoundary: All model responses use the explicitly isolated mock adapter. Sessions, actual tools, stream/turn events, lineage, cancellation, durable reload, routing, RPC and continuation are real DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

browserQA.browserPlugin: not listed; mandatory agent-browser skill used
browserQA.title: 持久子会话模型控制 QA
browserQA.runtime: Actual DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 AgentLoop and continuable child; production getRpcRoutes/service controls; existing Host React and Modal primitives
browserQA.vendor: Explicit isolated mock provider; no real ChatGPT/Claude/TypeSafe model calls by this reviewer
browserQA.connectionBoundary: Loopback QA bridge uses actual production RPC handlers. It does not certify the full production Web cookie/trust middleware or visual theme composition.
flow: Open the model/recovery action in an actual persistent child conversation
Select recovered and reasoning max while the actual observed call remains hang/high
Actual Host cancellation ends the child run; Continue is unavailable until real settlement and pipeline cleanup
Use Continue with read-only guidance; the same child actually calls recovered/max
Observe idle/settled state and actual new delegation/attempt identity
Escape closes the Host Modal and returns to the model/recovery action
browserQA.processCleanup: Browser session closed and isolated preview Host terminated; production DSH service/configuration untouched

verifiedCorrections.bug: Cold persistent child attachments reuse Host attempt IDs such as child:1
verifiedCorrections.fix: Actual observation identity also binds the delegation; a new bound run cannot be suppressed as a duplicate

verifiedCorrections.bug: Changing the next chain could rewrite the cancelled old delegation route
verifiedCorrections.fix: Final route follows the actual last prepared/logged request, not selectedNext

verifiedCorrections.bug: Only success messages showed model identity
verifiedCorrections.fix: Failed assistant/attempt events also produce model-call rows; effective adapter defaults are read from the real logged request header at attempt start

verifiedCorrections.bug: Ordinary Host selectModel/cancel rejects subagent-owned sessions
verifiedCorrections.fix: A separate profile-owner control plane persists next selection, uses true ancestor cancellation, and resumes through the existing task/version/lease/budget pipeline

verifiedCorrections.bug: Old role chain quarantine blocked even a healthy user-selected new model
verifiedCorrections.fix: Resolve the exact continuation target and its persisted override before preflight

verifiedCorrections.bug: Generic continue could pick another recently used expert thread
verifiedCorrections.fix: Trusted controlledThreadId fixes the same durable child and refuses silent replacement on busy/closed/not-admitted targets

verifiedCorrections.bug: Immediate manual retry permit could be released by cancellation or remain held while idle
verifiedCorrections.fix: Queue a scoped intent; claim only at the real next request; reject true provider reset floors, and cancel intent before failed persistence unfences execution

verifiedCorrections.bug: Swarm prepend request-error handling suppressed Host context-overflow compaction
verifiedCorrections.fix: Call the actual compaction seam for context overflow, allow one recovery per logical request only after measured surface replacement, otherwise pause with context_recovery_required

verifiedCorrections.bug: Restart view required a live parent and recovered threads stayed closed
verifiedCorrections.fix: Root integration uses real readonly Host inspection/catalog plus official parent activation; same child cold resumes only with lineage/settled/current-task evidence

verifiedCorrections.bug: Unknown recovery blocked even correcting next model preference
verifiedCorrections.fix: Selection can be saved while remaining recovery-required; only execution/Continue stays gated

verifiedCorrections.bug: Side-effect prompt was inferred from role rather than actual operation
verifiedCorrections.fix: Trusted final allowed mutation boundary marks risk; completed runs clear it; actual lease recovery remains authoritative
verifiedCorrections.machineEvidence: Real allowed write modifies hello.txt once, next model call hangs; cancellation settles, unconfirmed continuation is refused, confirmed continuation reads the file and never repeats write.

verifiedCorrections.bug: Failed post-publication native registration could orphan a run or replay through a second backend
verifiedCorrections.fix: Published runs are disposed even if registration throws; native budget is retained and fallback replay is refused

verifiedCorrections.bug: The SDK seeds a later tool step from the last automatic fallback request/header; default effort materialization can also differ from that proposal
verifiedCorrections.fix: Official model/selection is the explicit intent source. Compatibility inference excludes the same actual provider/model regardless of adapter default effort; automatic headers cannot create a manual child override or cancel a root upgrade.
verifiedCorrections.machineEvidence: Real Host header sequence preferred → backup → preferred with zero child selection events; real validated root model/selection followed by a recovered/max request.

verifiedCorrections.bug: Retaining only currently usable routes discarded preferred candidates and prevented later recovery
verifiedCorrections.fix: Retain the current attempt compatible declared chain with its initial usable route. New logical step boundaries recheck metadata, vision, generation/tools and scoped health; actual dispatch atomically claims one half-open owner. Same logical retries cannot rewind; failed trials back off.

verifiedCorrections.bug: Root upgrades could retain an automatic fallback outside the original upgrade chain after cancellation
verifiedCorrections.fix: Clearing an upgrade removes its automatic root fallback and preserves stable human preference. Restore preference from own explicit selection or first initial/resume header; rootRecoverMs remains authoritative, including zero disabling automatic restoration.

verifiedCorrections.bug: After separating the stable picker from SDK headers, root restoration could rebind quota policy from the old fallback header
verifiedCorrections.fix: Bind trusted configured resource policy to preferredRoot itself. Regression verifies a preferred-account failure cannot quarantine the fallback account.

remainingBoundaries: Machine/model-source tests are not independent Jev certification. This reviewer did not call external Jev MCP.
Native backends without Host model evidence explicitly show unknown; no native placeholder is presented as a verified model.
Cold orphaned/open/conflicting turns, pending delivery and unknown mutations remain recovery-required; confirmation does not clear unknown execution leases.
Parent agent owns full repository tests, deployment, version bump and release. These hashes are current owned files at report time, not a whole-release freeze claim.
